title: Cilan Series Modern Curved kitchenry with Island BLCC22300
description:
kitchenry with Wood Curved Island

It is a bold modern red kitchenry design with a wood slat curved island. The high cabinets and the countertop are curved in design, lovely, and full of interest. These kitchen units and the island create a young, fashionable complete kitchen in popular white and lotus red tunes. The kitchen layout is parallel. The designer combines the bar counter with the countertop’s washing and cooking areas to make the kitchen look more casual and layered.

Built-in refrigerators, steam ovens, and other electrical appliances are integrated into the high cabinets, making the kitchen look more modern and orderly. The kitchen is not only beautiful but also very functional. It can be an open kitchen as a leisure and social place.

Curve Fluted Kitchen Island

The fluted kitchen island is a curved design, looks beautiful, and adds softness to the sleek modern kitchen. The curved island design not only adds warmth, coziness, and texture to a contemporary kitchen but also brings more visual interest. Since the kitchen space is often limited, a rounded corner design island can facilitate movement around the kitchen and be safer for families with kids.

Small Round Dining Table On The Island

There is an extended small round dining table on the island. Under the table, there are two stools for seating. Here you can enjoy wine and informal meals in comfort.

White and Red Kitchen

Red is full of personality and attractive. The kitchen is in a two-tone design. It features a bold red and soft white tone combination and is full of personality and appeal. The red tone adds passion and warmth to the cooking space, while the white tone adds a pure and clean feel to the design. In color psychology, red is a color that can stimulate hunger. So it suits to use in a cooking and dining space. Cooking will be fun, and having meals here will be happy here.

title: Stindee Series Contemporary White Kitchen Design with Green Island BLCC23070
description:
kitchens

This contemporary kitchen design features a galley layout with one wall of cream-white lacquer finished cabinets and a dark green lacquer finish island. The cabinets have a handleless design, giving the kitchen a sleek and modern look. All kitchen appliances are built-in, further contributing to the minimalist appearance of the space.

Dark Green Kitchen Island

The kitchen island is a standout feature of the design, shaped and lustrous like a cut emerald. It has a bar countertop with seating for two, providing a casual dining option. The island’s dark green finish ties in with the wine rack and adds color to the otherwise neutral color scheme. Overall, this contemporary kitchen design incorporates sleek lines, minimalism, and pops of color to create a functional and stylish space.

The open shelving design in the middle of the wall adds a unique touch to the kitchen. To the right of the open shelving, there is a wine rack with a special design. The rack is designed to hold wine bottles horizontally for storage and decoration. The back panels of the wine rack can glow and change color, adding a contemporary and stylish element to the kitchen.

Sideboard

The sideboard is simple and elegant with integrated handles, retaining the integrated product design. The handle and panel are integrated, which has a wider field of vision, creates a popular entry premium style. The sideboard adopts air hinges, so that when the door is closed, the hinges are invisible from the door. It breaks through the traditional installation and design requirements, and maximizes the artistry of the door without affecting the conditions of use.

title: Hinged Fitted Wardrobe in Off White and Elephant Grey OBW23-L04
description:
A modern-style hinged fitted wardrobe offers a sleek and spacious solution for all your storage needs. It features a built-in design that extends up-to-ceiling, maximizing vertical space in your room. The symmetrical layout includes top cabinets, hinged cupboards, and open shelves, offering ample storage for clothes, accessories, and items you want to display.

The wardrobe has eight hinged doors, four on each side, presenting a balanced look. The center of the storage system includes two open shelves sandwiched between twelve drawers – six on the top and six on the bottom. This open shelving design adds a contemporary touch and is ideal for showcasing your favorite items.

The wardrobe and drawer doors are finished in a off-white lacquer, contrasting the matte elephant grey finish of the cabinet carcass and open shelves. The wardrobe doors are equipped with integrated horizontal brass pulls, while the drawers feature short square dark grey square metal pulls, adding a touch of sophistication.

The open shelves include integrated lighting, illuminating your display items and enhancing the overall aesthetic of the wardrobe. This modern hinged fitted wardrobe is about functionality, style, and elegance.

Hinged fitted wardrobes have several benefits that make them popular for bedroom storage. Here are some of them:

Maximized Space Utilization: Fitted wardrobes are custom-built for your space, extending from floor to ceiling and wall-to-wall, to make the most of every inch. It is particularly beneficial in rooms with unusual shapes or sizes.

Personalized Layouts: Hinged wardrobes allow for a tailored interior layout. You can choose the number and arrangement of shelves, drawers, and hanging spaces, meeting your unique storage needs.

Easy Access: Hinged doors open wide, providing easy access to the entire wardrobe. It’s simple to see and reach everything, making it less likely that items will be forgotten or lost at the back of the wardrobe.

Longevity and Durability: Hinged doors are sturdy and reliable. Unlike sliding doors, fewer components can malfunction, ensuring your wardrobe doors work seamlessly for years.

Design Versatility: Hinged wardrobes offer a wide range of design options. They can blend seamlessly with your room’s decor or design as a standout feature. Every element can be personalized, from the door style and finish to the handles.

Enhanced Room Aesthetics: A fitted hinged wardrobe can significantly enhance a room’s overall look and feel. With integrated lighting and the ability to display items on open shelves, these wardrobes can add an elegant and sophisticated feel to any bedroom.

Hinged fitted wardrobes offer a blend of practicality, personalization, and style, making them an excellent choice for modern homes.
